subject: Transition Ops Playbook: phased transfer, canary window & training plan — QuantumVault
messages:
From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@quantumvault.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@quantumvault.com>
Cc: Evan Cho <evan.cho@quantumvault.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature: ops cadence & MAP items we need from Redwood

Diego / team,

Thanks again — QuantumVault has signed the SOW and Procurement asked that we lock the mutual action plan (MAP) and a concrete canary/migration schedule before the kickoff. High level asks from our side: 

- A MAP workbook with ownership, deliverables, and acceptance gates.
- Proposed canary windows (one-week pilot, followed by two-week staged migration).
- Training dates for the ops and security teams (we need two 90-minute sessions and one train-the-trainer).
- Risk & rollback checklist tied to the canary.

We have a compliance review (SOC 2) starting 09/28; ideally we want core traffic on Redwood private nodes by 10/12 to demonstrate encrypted-in-transit behavior. Can you share your recommended rollout timeline and the MAP?

Attaching the signed SOW from our side for reference.

Appreciate a draft by EOD tomorrow if possible.

Best,
Samantha Reed
Director, Platform Operations
QuantumVault

Attachment: SOW_QV_Exec_Signed.pdf (stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@quantumvault.com>, Evan Cho <evan.cho@quantumvault.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@quantumvault.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature: ops cadence & MAP items we need from Redwood

Samantha — thanks, and congrats on the close. Sending an initial working MAP and a canary checklist attached (draft). High-level plan below; details are in MAP_QuantumVault_v1.2.xlsx.

Summary (draft):
- Phase 0 (09/20 - 09/24): Kickoff + environment provisioning (private control plane + staging). Ownership: Redwood infra (Diego) / QuantumVault infra (Evan). Gate: baseline perf test.
- Phase 1 Canary (10/04 - 10/10): Small subset of traffic via canary pool (5% traffic). Objective: monitor latency/cost/regression. Gate: quality metrics & rollback readiness.
- Phase 2 Staged Migration (10/11 - 10/24): 25% -> 60% -> 100% with validation at each step.
- Training: two operator sessions (09/28, 10/05), and one train-the-trainer (10/06).
- Rollback: immediate knob to divert to legacy endpoints + runbook steps (see CanaryChecklist.pdf).

Immediate asks for QuantumVault:
1) Confirm the two operator training attendees + preferred timezone (PT/ET).
2) Confirm the compliance checkpoint date (you mentioned 09/28).
3) Point person for runtime sizing and dedicated capacity (we need an internal contact).

Attachments: MAP_QuantumVault_v1.2.xlsx (workbook, tabs: milestones/owners/acceptance), CanaryChecklist.pdf (checklist & rollback triggers).

We can run a 45-minute alignment workshop tomorrow 11:00 PT if that works.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP_QuantumVault_v1.2.xlsx, CanaryChecklist.pdf

From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@quantumvault.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@quantumvault.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-signature: ops cadence & MAP items we need from Redwood

Thanks Diego — the draft looks good. A couple points from our side:

- SOC 2 reviewers will expect documented rollback windows and an audit trail for each canary step. Can you confirm logging retention and how tokenization/PII redaction is handled on Redwood Private?
- For the canary, we prefer an early-morning window (02:00–05:00 PT) for lowest risk; will Redwood's monitoring hooks support that?

On the training, we will have two operators and one platform engineer for the train-the-trainer session. I'll attach our initial attendee list after I confirm with Samantha.

Onward — Evan
Platform Engineering Manager
QuantumVault

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Transition Ops Playbook: phased transfer, canary window & training plan — QuantumVault

Laura / Marcus / Monica — forwarding the QuantumVault thread and draft MAP. They signed the SOW and request: concrete canary windows, rollback & audit trail details, and training dates. Please review attachments and confirm the items below by EOD Monday so I can send back an updated MAP: 

Action items (internal):
- Laura: Confirm monitoring/alerting hooks (audit logs retention; where we store canary traces) and propose log retention policy for this account.
- Marcus: Validate runtime sizing for the canary pool + dedicated capacity recommendation for Phase 2 (SLO targets: p95 < 120ms with current model).
- Monica: Prepare training outline (90-min operator sessions x2 + 1 train-the-trainer), and a short enablement doc.

Notes: I included the signed SOW in the thread (SOW_QuantVault_signed.pdf) — they are keen to hit SOC 2 demo on 09/28 and want a visible canary by 10/04 in a low-risk window (they prefer 02:00–05:00 PT).

I will consolidate your replies and update the MAP workbook with concrete owners and links to runbooks.

Thanks — Diego

Attachments forwarded: MAP_QuantumVault_v1.2.xlsx, CanaryChecklist.pdf, SOW_QuantVault_signed.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Transition Ops Playbook: phased transfer, canary window & training plan — QuantumVault

All — ACK and details below. I'll send updated MAP sheet once these items are embedded.

Laura (monitoring & compliance):
- Audit trail: enable full request/response tracing in the private control plane for canary traffic. Retention: 90 days by default for canary traces; we can extend to 365 days (cost impact noted in MAP tab 'retention-costs').
- PII/tokenization: Redwood Private supports field-level redaction before logging; will include config snippet in MAP.
- Canary windows: 02:00–05:00 PT is fine. We'll include monitoring runbooks and automated rollback triggers (error rate > 1.5% for 5m OR avg latency p95 degrade > 40%).

Marcus (runtime sizing):
- Recommend reserved capacity: 2x A100-equivalent for the canary pool (to avoid cold starts) and scalable pool for Phase 2 with autoscale thresholds at 70% utilization. I'll add the sizing tab + cost delta.

Monica (enablement & training):
- Proposed training schedule: Operator sessions: 2026-09-28 10:00 PT, 2026-10-05 10:00 PT. Train-the-trainer: 2026-10-06 10:00 PT. I will attach TrainingRoster.csv and a 1-page quickstart.

Next steps: Diego, I suggest we send the updated MAP + final canary checklist by 09/17 for QuantumVault review so they can sign off prior to their SOC 2 review. Marcus — please drop the sizing numbers into the MAP by EOD 09/16. Monica — please share the training slides draft by 09/16.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
